KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) — PD-1 Checkpoint Inhibitor
MECHANISM: Pembrolizumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody that blocks PD-1 on T cells, restoring anti-tumor immune response. PD-L1 on tumor cells normally suppresses T-cell activity; Keytruda prevents this.
KEY INDICATIONS (India approved): - NSCLC: 1st line for PD-L1 ≥50% (TPS), 1st line combo with chemo for all PD-L1, 2nd line PD-L1 ≥1% - Melanoma: 1st line monotherapy, adjuvant resected stage IIB-IV - HNSCC: 1st line PD-L1 CPS ≥1 (monotherapy/combo) - Triple-negative breast cancer: 1st line combo if PD-L1 CPS ≥10 - MSI-H/dMMR solid tumors: tissue-agnostic approval
DOSING: 200 mg IV Q3W or 400 mg IV Q6W (flat dose, no weight-based)
KEYNOTE TRIALS (key data points): - KEYNOTE-024: 45% ORR vs 28% chemo in NSCLC PD-L1 ≥50% - KEYNOTE-189: Added to pemetrexed+carboplatin — OS benefit all-comer NSCLC - KEYNOTE-522: pCR improvement in TNBC (64.8% vs 51.2%)
BIOMARKER TESTING: PD-L1 IHC (TPS/CPS), MSI/dMMR testing essential before initiation
SAFETY: irAEs — pneumonitis, colitis, hepatitis, endocrinopathies, dermatitis. Manage with steroids. Grade 3+ → hold/discontinue.
COMPETITIVE DIFFERENTIATION vs Opdivo: Flat dosing, more approved indications in India, longer overall survival data in several tumor types.

KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) — Key Talking Points for Reps
KYA HAI: Yeh ek immunotherapy hai — PD-1 block karta hai toh body ki T-cells tumor ko attack kar sakti hain. Simple language mein: "Immune system ka darwaza kholta hai tumor ke liye."
KAHAN USE HOTA HAI: - Lung cancer (NSCLC): Pehli line mein agar PD-L1 test positive hai (≥50%). Akele bhi, chemo ke saath bhi. - Melanoma: Pehli line treatment - Mouth/throat cancer (HNSCC): PD-L1 positive mein - Triple-negative breast cancer: PD-L1 high ho toh - Kisi bhi cancer mein agar MSI-H/dMMR test positive — yeh unique hai!
DOSE: 200 mg har 3 hafte (ya 400 mg har 6 hafte) — weight se nahi, fixed dose hai. Easy hai patient aur doctor ke liye.
DOCTOR SE KAISE BAAT KAREIN: - "Dr. saab, aapke lung cancer patients mein PD-L1 testing ho rahi hai? Keytruda pehli line mein kaafi strong data hai KEYNOTE-024 se." - "Agar MSI-H patient hai kisi bhi solid tumor mein, Keytruda tissue-agnostic approved hai India mein."
SIDE EFFECTS (irAEs): Immune system zyada active ho jata hai — lungs, liver, gut affected ho sakte hain. Steroids se manage hote hain. Doctor ko yeh pata hona chahiye.
VS OPDIVO: Keytruda ka flat dosing advantage hai, aur India mein zyada indications hain.
